subtasks.title: Headless /refs/pick candidate enumeration + /refs/pick/select endpoint
subtasks.prompt:
Implement the server side of headless folder/file picking, per PLAN.md's "Server: candidate enumeration + selection", "src/bun/server.ts changes", "Server tests", and "Webview: src/mainview/lib/api.ts" sections.

1. Create src/bun/refs-pick.ts exporting MAX_PICK_CANDIDATES = 50, headlessPickCandidates(): string[], and selectPick(rawPath, mode: "files"|"folder"): { refs: TaskReference[] } | { error: string }, exactly as specified in PLAN.md (priority order: task workdirs by updatedAt desc, then non-dot git-repo dirs one level under homedir() sorted alphabetically, then homedir() itself; dedup+cap via realpathSync with silent drop on failure; selectPick validates absolute path, existence, directory-ness, and for "files" mode lists immediate non-hidden regular files sorted by localeCompare).
2. Edit src/bun/server.ts: replace the `if (!native) return notAvailableHeadless(req);` branch in the /refs/pick route with the candidates response described in PLAN.md, and add the new POST /refs/pick/select route immediately after /refs/pick, exactly as specified (including its request/response shape and status codes). Do not touch the fake-seam or native-dialog branches of /refs/pick.
3. Write src/bun/refs-pick.test.ts covering every case listed under PLAN.md's "New file: src/bun/refs-pick.test.ts".
4. Edit src/bun/refs-endpoint.test.ts: replace the now-incorrect "/refs/pick is unavailable in headless mode..." test and add the new tests listed under PLAN.md's "Edits to existing src/bun/refs-endpoint.test.ts", leaving every other existing test in that file untouched.
5. Edit src/mainview/lib/api.ts's pickRefs per PLAN.md's "Webview" section (defensive-only change, no new UI).

Run `bun run typecheck` and `bun test src/bun/refs-pick.test.ts src/bun/refs-endpoint.test.ts` until green.

subtasks.title: CLI client methods + interactive TUI DirPickerOverlay + Dashboard wiring
subtasks.prompt:
Implement the CLI/TUI side of headless folder/file picking, per PLAN.md's "CLI: src/cli/api-client.ts", "TUI: new src/cli/tui/DirPickerOverlay.tsx", "TUI: src/cli/tui/Dashboard.tsx wiring", and "TUI test" sections. Work against the HTTP contract exactly as documented in PLAN.md (POST /refs/pick returns either { refs } for a direct result or { candidates } for headless enumeration; POST /refs/pick/select takes { path, mode } and returns { refs } with 200 or { error } with 400) — do not depend on or read src/bun/refs-pick.ts or src/bun/server.ts; build entirely against the documented contract and mock it in tests.

1. Add pickRefs and selectPickedRef methods to AgetorClient in src/cli/api-client.ts as specified.
2. Create src/cli/tui/DirPickerOverlay.tsx implementing the full state machine described in PLAN.md ("kind" -> "loading" -> "dirlist"/"manual"/"fileslist" screens), matching AnswerOverlay.tsx's component style/pattern. Implement every behavior listed: direct-result short-circuit, candidate filtering (case-insensitive substring), keyboard navigation, manual path entry with ~ expansion and relative-path resolution against process.cwd(), inline error-and-retry on invalid manual paths, back-out semantics at each screen, and the files-mode two-level flow.
3. Edit src/cli/tui/Dashboard.tsx: add "pick" to the Mode union, import DirPickerOverlay/appendReferences/TaskReference, add the `r` keybinding, the pick-mode render block, and the Footer hint updates, exactly as specified in PLAN.md's wiring section.
4. Write src/cli/tui/DirPickerOverlay.test.tsx covering every scenario listed in PLAN.md's TUI test section, using a hand-built fake AgetorClient and the same ink-testing-library harness pattern as AnswerOverlay.test.tsx.

Run `bun run typecheck` and `bun test src/cli/tui/DirPickerOverlay.test.tsx src/cli/tui/Dashboard.test.tsx` until green.
